measurement: Exact UTF8 body bytes and explicitly labeled JSON serialization sizes. No token estimation or monetary inference; provider usage integers are synthetic.
deploymentBoundary: Loom native-final is an explicitly enabled trial in this isolated daemon; deployed defaults were not changed.
limits: One controlled synthetic trajectory, not provider token-cost or business-quality acceptance.
Shared ACP bridge reuses product transport code and cannot independently validate that bridge.
print uses native auto permission reminders; ACP uses manual delegated tool approval.
Cwd/system text and first-turn standing pointer paths differ; these are reported bytes, not pure causal protocol overhead.
Full tool outputs contain dynamic Wall time values; only command and actual business stdout payload are fixed.
Serialized component byte sizes include their own JSON delimiters; they are structural measures, not additive token attribution.
Initial instructions enter history once and are retransmitted in each later request; this is distinct from new wake reinjection.
